name: The Sky Tears
flavor: A sound like ripping canvas rolls across the world.

tiers.text: A rift opens.
A rift opens, and something comes through a rift elsewhere.
Two rifts open.

name: Whispers on the Wire
flavor: Telegraph operators across the world receive the same garbled message.

tiers.text: Two clues surface as the message is decoded.
A clue surfaces. Every investigator tests Nerve or loses 1 Sanity.
Every investigator tests Nerve (-1) or loses 2 Sanity.

name: The Hunt Begins
flavor: Dogs howl in every city at once, then fall silent.

tiers.text: Roaming monsters move toward investigators.
Roaming monsters move, and a new monster appears.
Roaming monsters move twice.

name: Strange Tides
flavor: The sea pulls back from every harbor, and fishermen walk out on the mud to stare.

tiers.text: Investigators at sea test Nerve or lose 1 Sanity.
Investigators at sea test Nerve or lose 2 Sanity. A monster comes out of the water.
Investigators at sea lose 2 Sanity. A rift opens.

name: Panic on the Exchange
flavor: Stocks fall, banks close early, and the price of everything changes overnight.

tiers.text: The market turns over.
Every investigator loses 1 Funds.
Every investigator loses 2 Funds, and the market turns over.

name: A Quiet Night
flavor: For one night, the world holds its breath.

tiers.text: Every investigator recovers 1 Sanity, and two clues surface.
A clue surfaces.
The quiet is only waiting. A rift opens.

name: The Faithful Gather
flavor: Robed figures meet in basements and on hilltops, chanting the same words.

tiers.text: A Cultist appears at a rift site.
Cultists appear at each open rift.
Monsters appear at each open rift, and Doom advances by 1.

name: Fever Dreams
flavor: The whole world sleeps badly.

tiers.text: Every investigator's Madness conditions come due.
Every investigator's conditions come due.
Every investigator's conditions come due. The investigator with the lowest Sanity gains Night Terrors.

name: Debts Come Due
flavor: Lawyers, creditors, and policemen all seem to find you at once.

tiers.text: Every investigator's Debt and Legal conditions come due.
Debt and Legal conditions come due. Investigators with 3 or more Funds lose 1.
Every investigator loses 1 Funds, and every condition comes due.

name: Lights in the North
flavor: The aurora burns as far south as Rome, in colors that have no names.

tiers.text: A clue surfaces.
A rift opens.
A rift opens, and roaming monsters move.

name: The Wounded Stir
flavor: Things that should have died in the dark crawl back into the light.

tiers.text: Every wounded monster recovers.
Monsters recover, and a new monster appears.
Monsters recover, and a monster appears at each open rift.

name: Blood Moon
flavor: The moon rises red and stays red until dawn.

tiers.text: Every investigator tests Nerve or loses 1 Sanity.
Every investigator tests Nerve (-1) or loses 1 Sanity.
Every investigator tests Nerve (-1). On a fail, lose 1 Sanity and become Hexed.

name: A Ship Goes Missing
flavor: The SS Annalise sails out of Lisbon and is never heard from again.

tiers.text: The goods it carried never arrive. The market turns over.
Investigators at sea test Wits or are delayed.
Investigators at sea test Wits (-1). On a fail, they are delayed and lose 1 Health.

name: Scholars Vanish
flavor: Professors in three countries fail to show up for their lectures.

tiers.text: The investigator with the most Clues tests Wits or loses 1 Clue.
The investigator with the most Clues tests Wits or loses 2 Clues.
Every investigator with Clues loses 1.

name: A Kind Stranger
flavor: Not everyone has forgotten how to help.

tiers.text: The investigator with the lowest Health recovers 2 Health and 1 Sanity.
The investigator with the lowest Health recovers 1 Health.
The stranger leaves only a note. A clue surfaces.

name: A Forgotten Cache
flavor: A dead investigator's luggage turns up in a railway lost-property office.

tiers.text: A random investigator gains an item.
A random investigator gains 2 Funds.
Something followed the luggage. Roaming monsters move.

name: The Veil Thins
flavor: For an hour at midnight, you can see through walls into somewhere else.

tiers.text: Two rifts open.
Two rifts open, and Doom advances by 1.

name: The Dreams Spread
flavor: Children draw the same strange city in schools on three continents.

tiers.text: Every investigator tests Nerve (-1). On a fail, lose 1 Sanity and gain Night Terrors.
Every investigator loses 1 Sanity and gains Night Terrors.

name: Monster Surge
flavor: The rifts disgorge their passengers.

tiers.text: A monster appears at each open rift.
A monster appears at each open rift, and roaming monsters move.

name: The Watchers
flavor: You feel eyes on the back of your neck, and when you turn there is no one there.

tiers.text: A random investigator is Marked by the Watcher.
Every investigator is Marked by the Watcher.

name: The Cult Ascendant
flavor: A senator, a bishop, and a newspaper owner are seen at the same midnight meeting.

tiers.text: Doom advances by 1.
Doom advances by 1, and a rift opens.

name: Society Frays
flavor: Riots, curfews, and the police on every corner.

tiers.text: Investigators in a city test Charm or become Wanted by the Police.
Investigators in a city test Charm (-1). On a fail, they become Wanted and lose 1 Funds.

name: The Stars Align
flavor: Astronomers stop publishing. They are too frightened of what they see.

tiers.text: Doom advances by 2.

name: The Hour Is Late
flavor: Clocks everywhere run fast.

tiers.text: Every investigator loses 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

name: The Rifts Burst
flavor: The holes in the world are no longer holes. They are mouths.

tiers.text: Two rifts open, and a monster appears at each open rift.

name: Despair
flavor: What is the point? It is already too late.

tiers.text: Every investigator tests Nerve (-2) or loses 2 Sanity.
